shortened_for_single_host.note: the acceptance spec asks for a 60s warm-up, 5min per ladder step, >=3 rounds per step and a 60min soak; this run uses the values above on a single Docker Desktop host

overload.why: the knee is the best sustained M-shape start rate of the closed-loop M ladder (and the warm-up closed rounds) observed earlier in this run

limiter.why: the Demo default of 20 rps would make every ladder a limiter measurement

generator.validity_rule: drops > 0.1% of scheduled arrivals or arrivals < 99% of the plan (open-loop rounds) invalidate the round for capacity conclusions
